title: SG-2.2 Author the boy sheet and portrait
summary: Generate a 32x48 boy sheet (idle 4, walk 6, interact 4) and a 32x32 portrait, declared in the manifest
description: Context: the art pipeline (draw helpers, ArtSource, generateAssets, art:generate) exists and the room grids are authored (SG-2.1). Boy art is still SVG. Desired behavior: palette-indexed grids for the boy and portrait are authored, generated to PNG by art:generate, and the manifest declares the animations with frame ranges and rates. Expected result: PNGs at declared sizes using only palette colours. Why: replaces placeholder character art. Switching content to PNGs is SG-2.3, not this intent.
acceptance_criteria: Given the boy sheet source, when generated, then the PNG is 448x48 holding 14 frames of 32x48
Given the manifest, when read, then idle, walk and interact declare frame ranges 0-3, 4-9 and 10-13 with frame rates
Given the portrait source, when generated, then the PNG is 32x32 and uses only palette colours

in_scope: animation and origin support in generated manifest entries
unit tests for frame counts and size
preserve: existing character:boy, boy-walk and boy-interact SVG entries

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
All art is raster pixel art generated in-repo from source data by a deterministic script; no downloaded art
One shared palette of at most 48 colours
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
definition_of_done: All requirements met with Act and Verify units green
